pregame.whyWatch: Julian Sayin (OSU QB, Jr): 1530 pass yds, 13 TD, 1 INT, 10.8 Y/A. Big plays with almost no turnovers. The test is whether he still pushes the ball when the first read is covered and the pocket gets muddy.
pregame.pressurePoint: Ohio State run game vs Indiana run defense. Indiana is No. 4 of 138 against the run (26%). Ohio State ranks No. 67 in rush success rate (45%). A clear edge, the kind that shapes a game plan. Ohio State will find the run hard going. Expect more second-and-long than usual. Watch Ohio State's yards per carry through the first quarter. Under 3 and the game plan has to change.

edges.why: Indiana is No. 8 of 138 in pass explosiveness (1.88). Ohio State ranks No. 85 at limiting explosive passes (1.59). This is not a lean. It is a mismatch, and a prominent one. Ohio State does not keep the lid on. Indiana will take shots, and the market total may be underpriced if they land.
